title: Universität Hamburg: Merit Scholarships for International Students
summary: Merit support for international degree students already enrolled at Hamburg. The university currently states that no further application calls are planned.

degree_levels.notes: The current detailed rules explicitly exclude doctoral researchers.

subject_areas.notes: The introduction says all subjects; current degree-specific requirements govern.

institutions.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

nationality.notes: German citizenship, including dual German citizenship, is excluded.

residence.notes: Residence permit or EU ID plus German residence registration is required.

mandatory.text: At least two completed semesters in the subject at Hamburg; for a two-year Master's degree, one completed semester is sufficient.
Applicants must not be eligible for BAföG under Section 8.
Two evaluations from eligible full-time doctoral teaching staff at Hamburg, using the university template.
No academic leave or study-abroad semester during funding; a German bank account is required for payment.
The page caps additional earnings at EUR 603 monthly and disallows other additional funding.

funding.description: Up to EUR 992 per month; award for 12 months, with reapplication possible up to two years total.
funding.duration: Two semesters (12 months); reapplication up to a maximum total of two years.

application_rounds.notes: The university explicitly states no further calls are currently planned. An older 15 April application link remains on the page and must not be treated as a confirmed future round.

required_documents.text: Motivation letter using the university template
Current academic transcript or STiNE record; Master's students also submit their previous degree certificate
Residence permit, or EU ID and German residence registration
Two evaluations using the university's form
Evidence of additional academic achievements or awards, where applicable

steps.text: Check whether the university has announced a new call before preparing an application.
If a call resumes, register using the student email address and upload a complete application through the university portal.

sources.title: Merit scholarships : UHH : University of Hamburg
sources.notes: The official source describes funding for international students studying in Germany.

review_notes: Provider explicitly suspends further calls; retain for coverage and historical context and do not display as open.
